observations.text: Verified Program.cs: AddFlowMetrics at line 1253 runs before RegisterDomainEventHandlers (line 1388, handlers from 1405); TeamDataRefreshedTeamMetricsUpdateHandler is registered first and ProcessBehaviorRecordingHandler sits at lines 1426-1427, so the D13 ordering reason for a Program.cs registration is real. DomainEventHandlerOrderPinTest lists both refresh orders and the design names it in S7.

Verified PercentilesOverTimeSnapshot.RecordedAt is the day key; OverTimeHistoryFiller has two TryWriteDayAsync calls (percentiles line 342, limits line 352), so a within-SLE family as the third is consistent with D15; RetentionEdge, LostRaceTolerantSave, IPercentileSnapshotWriter and ReconstructionMemo exist as cited.

Verified ragRulesTimeAndAge.ts defines calculateSLEStats (line 3) and computeCycleTimePercentilesRag (line 71, used in widgetFooters.ts line 204), so the D4 residual duplicate and the D8 extraction are grounded.

The header-trend rule of no comparison when either period has fewer than 5 closed is marked Proposed in brief.md line 520 and feature-delta.md line 132; D7 adopts it and says it awaits Product confirmation, so no product decision is invented. Advice for the user: confirm it before S6 ships.

Formal model: the receipt records typecheck, four quint run invariants and an Apalache verify with no violation, plus four mutants each violating one invariant; D16 and D17 scope the claims honestly. I did not replay the model check in this review.

Test substrate: K9 drives the three application ports through ServicePortHarness, hosts only as a named skeleton or wire contract; migration expand-only via CreateMigration (K8); slice ids S5-S8 are consistent. Note: ADR-003.md shares its number with adr-003-emergency-admin-display.md, but ADR-001 and ADR-002 already use the same uppercase nwdes scheme, so numbering is nwdes-owned, not a design defect.

diagnostic: Design accepted: Program.cs ordering, RecordedAt day key, filler reuse, frontend residual duplicate and test substrate verified against code; no blocking findings. Advice: Product to confirm the Proposed header-trend rule before S6.
